recognize_zh: 一顆大型三核細胞，三個圓形核染色質細緻、位於周邊，深藍色細胞質內散布細小空泡，具漿細胞樣分化特徵，代表核分裂未伴隨細胞分裂；周圍有小淋巴球與紅血球母細胞，圖中未能清楚辨認 Russell 小體。
features: Large atypical cell with three round, peripherally placed nuclei
Nuclei with finely granular chromatin and indistinct nucleoli
Moderately abundant basophilic cytoplasm containing multiple small clear vacuoles
Plasmacytoid features; distinct Russell bodies not clearly seen
Surrounding small lymphocytes, erythroblasts and a band neutrophil
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large atypical trinucleated cell with three round, peripherally placed nuclei, finely granular chromatin and moderately abundant basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous small clear vacuoles. The appearance suggests nuclear division without cytokinesis in a cell with plasmacytoid differentiation, although well-formed Russell bodies are not clearly identifiable in this image. Small lymphocytes, erythroid precursors and a band neutrophil are present nearby. In a patient with CLL, findings are consistent with atypical multinucleated plasmablastic cells, supporting Richter transformation to plasmablastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts are much larger with many (often >5) uniform separate nuclei and abundant granular pink-purple cytoplasm.
Megakaryocytes have a single multilobated polyploid nucleus and granular cytoplasm rather than separate nuclei in basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with multinucleated plasma cells
ddx.vs: Multinucleated myeloma cells can look identical, so clinical M-protein, CRAB features and prior CLL history with immunophenotype are needed.
RS cells have large inclusion-like macronucleoli and are CD30/CD15 positive, lacking plasmacytoid basophilic cytoplasm.
